LightningComponentBundle.description: Matches candidates to a Talent Pool with tunable weightings for silver medalists, engagement, redeployment and VMS readiness.

property.name: searchTitle
property.label: Search title (optional)
property.description: Job title sent to TextKernel. Leave blank to derive it from the Talent Pool name, for example 'Delivery Driver Talent Pool' becomes 'Delivery Driver'.

property.name: searchCity
property.label: Search city (optional)
property.description: City to centre the search on. Leave blank to search without a location.
